narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -4.99 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 1.476-1.504 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 1.526; the first objective pays 2.25R at 1.462.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 1.526 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 36/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below, funding still cool

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $59k -1.6% below · short liq $16k +3.1% above

funding: venues missing from the OI chart were weighted at the mean OI of matched venues
funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
